heroSourceLine: Official 2025–26 ESD Family and Community Calendar
heroSummary: Edmonds School District starts grades 1–12 on Wednesday, September 3, 2025. Kindergarten begins September 8 after Family Connection meetings, Edmonds Preschool begins September 22, and the scheduled last day is June 18, 2026, with a districtwide half-day release.
calendarNotes: ESD starts grades 1–12 on September 3, so families should not apply that date to every program. Kindergarten uses Family Connection meetings before its September 8 first day, which creates a separate opening-week care plan. Edmonds Preschool begins September 22, so preschool families have a longer gap before the regular program starts. Fridays in session use a 75-minute early release after the first-Friday exception, which means dismissal time changes almost every instructional week. Elementary conference dates are half days rather than full closures, so transportation and afternoon care still need a shortened-day plan. Snow make-up dates are activated in a published order beginning May 22 and then extending beyond the scheduled last day, so June travel should leave room for a possible extension. The PDF and this ICS are fixed snapshots, so families should use ESD's live calendar subscription for later changes.

customSections.label: ESD Snow Make-Up Dates Have a Fixed Order
customSections.content: The PDF gives a specific sequence rather than five interchangeable reserve dates. The order is May 22, June 22, June 23, June 24, then June 25. Until ESD activates a date, May 22 remains a no-school staff-development day and the June dates remain outside the scheduled student year.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Edmonds School District start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Grades 1–12 start Wednesday, September 3, 2025. Kindergarten Family Connection meetings run September 3–5, kindergarten starts September 8, and Edmonds Preschool starts September 22.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Friday early release begin in Edmonds for 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: The first 75-minute early-release Friday is September 12, 2025. September 5 is explicitly a full school day with no early release. Later Fridays follow the recurring pattern when school is in session.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Edmonds School District Winter Break in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 22, 2025, through January 2, 2026. Students return Monday, January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Edmonds School District Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs April 6–10, 2026. Students return Monday, April 13.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of Edmonds School District in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The scheduled last day is Thursday, June 18, 2026, with a half-day early release for all grades. Snow make-up days could extend the year beginning June 22 after the May 22 option.

calendarFaqs.q: Are Edmonds elementary conference days full closures?
calendarFaqs.a: No. October 27–30, 2025, and March 11–12, 2026, are elementary half-day early releases for conferences. Students attend for part of the day.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 8, 2026, against ESD's official calendar page, start-and-dismissal page, and the complete one-page 2025–26 English Family and Community Calendar.
sourceReviewDetails: The PDF was rendered and checked visually because colors and symbols distinguish Friday release, elementary conference half days, districtwide half days, no-school days, first days, term endings, and snow make-up dates.
The exact Friday dates were transcribed from the color-coded calendar. They are grouped in the schedule guide instead of repeated as individual ICS events.
The snow make-up sequence was preserved in the PDF's stated order: May 22, followed by June 22–25.
ESD's current start-and-dismissal page provides school-specific bell-time context but is labeled for 2025–26, so exact times are not generalized to other years.
